data_controller.title: Data Controller
data_controller.content: Convention de Jonglerie is the data controller for your personal data. We are committed to protecting your privacy and processing your personal data transparently and in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

data_collected.title: Data Collected
data_collected.intro: We collect the following types of personal data:

items.identity: Identity information: last name, first name, username
items.preferences: User preferences: favorite conventions, notification settings

purpose.title: Processing Purposes
purpose.intro: Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:

legal_basis.title: Legal Basis
legal_basis.content: The processing of your personal data is based on your consent for account creation and service use, as well as our legitimate interest in improving our services and platform security.

data_sharing.title: Data Sharing
data_sharing.content: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties, except in the following cases: legal obligation, protection of our rights, or with your explicit consent. Data may be shared with our technical service providers strictly within the scope of service provision.

data_retention.title: Data Retention
data_retention.content: Your personal data is retained for the duration necessary for the purposes for which it was collected. Accounts inactive for more than 3 years may be deleted after prior notification.

user_rights.title: Your Rights
user_rights.intro: In accordance with GDPR, you have the following rights:

items.access: Right of access: obtain a copy of your personal data
items.rectification: Right of rectification: correct your inaccurate or incomplete data
items.erasure: Right to erasure: delete your personal data
items.portability: Right to portability: retrieve your data in a structured format
items.objection: Right to objection: object to the processing of your data

cookies.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.content: We use technical cookies necessary for the site's operation, particularly for managing your login session. These cookies do not require your prior consent as they are strictly necessary for service provision.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or unauthorized destruction.

updates.title: Policy Updates
updates.content: This privacy policy may be updated periodically. We will inform you of any substantial changes by email or via a notification on the site.
